edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the value movement to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_transfer finalizes accounting by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers an external Uniswap swap before completing its own accounting.
_transfer sends ETH to the tax wallet from within the transfer flow.
swapForTax calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
collectTax pushes ETH out via sendETHToFee.
airdrop loops calling _tokenTransfer for each recipient.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swap call.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to the tax wallet.
_transfer calls the external O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount view for the buy-limit check.
addLiquidity performs an external payable router call adding ETH liquidity.
createUniswapPair calls the external Uniswap factory createPair.
createUniswapPair stores the returned pair address into _pair.
addLiquidity enables the fee-swap flag _swapEnabled.
_tokenTransfer writes sender, recipient and contract balances.
grant mints tokens into an arbitrary recipient balance without cap.
grant increases _tTotal, diluting existing holders.
lowerTax rewrites the transfer tax rate.
removeBuyLimit sets _maxTxAmount to the full supply, disabling buy limits.
addToWhitelist toggles fee exclusion for an arbitrary address.
removeFromWhitelist toggles fee exclusion for an arbitrary address.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited source address.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is spent.
msg.sender influences fee-exclusion checks inside _transfer.
grant relies on msg.sender matching the tax wallet for authorization.
collectTax relies on msg.sender matching the tax wallet for authorization.
block.timestamp is passed directly as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed directly as the liquidity deadline.
tTeam is computed by mul/div of the transfer amount and tax rate.
tTransferAmount is computed by subtraction of tax from the amount.
amount parameter drives balance updates and limit checks in _transfer.
from parameter is used for zero-address and fee-exclusion checks.
to parameter selects the pair/limit branches in _transfer.
sender parameter is debited in _tokenTransfer.
recipient parameter is credited in _tokenTransfer.
tAmount parameter is the base for tax computations.
taxRate parameter scales the tax amount.
path local array is populated and passed to the router swap.
contractTokenBalance captures balanceOf(address(this)) during _transfer.
contractETHBalance captures address(this).balance during _transfer.
grant credits the supplied recipient address.
grant adds the supplied amount to balance and total supply.
airdrop iterates over the recipients array parameter.
airdrop uses the amount parameter for every transfer.
lowerTax validates and assigns the newTaxRate parameter.

contractETHBalance is a temporary local of _transfer.
